_what: The transparency strip (register v3, in scope 12 Aug 2026): official data series that have stopped updating, with the date of each source's last official release. Factual and dated only - the definition is printed on the page; no characterisation beyond what happened.
_rules: An entry needs: an official series this board uses or would use; a verifiable last-release date; a citation. A source LEAVES the list by publishing again (checked at every build via the note field's owning connector where applicable). Dates verified 12 Aug 2026 (research trail in project docs 02/04).

sources.name: DoD public casualty report (casualty.pdf)
sources.note: Weekly PDF frozen ten days into the term; never extended to 2025–26 operations. The DCAS database (which this board uses) remains current.

sources.name: ICE public enforcement dashboard
sources.note: Dashboard frozen; the biweekly detention workbook (which this board uses) continues.

sources.name: DHS OHSS monthly enforcement tables
sources.note: Final release carried data through Nov 2024; no release since.

sources.name: DOJ clemency statistics
sources.note: Historical statistics tables frozen; the grants pages (which this board uses) continue.

sources.name: DOJ Capitol Breach (Jan 6) cases database
sources.note: Removed days after the inauguration; deleted with ~1,100 case press releases in May 2026. Archived copies preserved by third parties.

sources.name: ICE detainee death reporting (full scope)
sources.note: Not frozen but narrowed: deaths within 30 days of release are no longer reported (Directive 11003.6). The in-custody series (which this board uses) continues under the narrower rule.

sources.name: VoteHub approval poll feed
sources.note: Non-government source (poll aggregator): no new national approval polls ingested since late June; disclosed on the approval card, checked daily.
